The brochure shows ₹42 LPA, but when I looked at the actual placement data, College B's median starting salary is only ₹4.6 LPA versus College A's ₹4.2 LPA—that's ₹40,000 per year difference. Meanwhile, College B costs ₹6.5 lakh more over 4 years. That's almost a full year of Papa's salary for just ₹40,000 extra per year. The math doesn't work for our family.

What also bothered me was the counsellor calling to pressure us: "pay ₹25,000 by tomorrow or lose the seat." And then finding out they get commission for each student they enroll—that felt like a sales pitch, not genuine guidance. The "100% PLACEMENT ASSISTANCE" in the brochure is misleading too; the actual data shows only 70% got placed, meaning 30% didn't. Even the placement difference itself is just 6%.

I know relatives think College B is a "big name" and my cousin's success there matters to them. But College A is only 60 km away, the seniors say the labs are old but teaching is okay, and the cost is something we can actually manage without crushing my parents. That matters more to me than a name.
